newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance stg bond oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance stg bond oversubscribed.

text.p: Indian petrochemicals firm Reliance Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that its 150 million sterling pound bond issue was oversubscribed 1.5 to 2.0 times.
The issue, priced on Tuesday, is the first sterling issue by an Indian company.
The bond raised 9.0 billion rupees in Indian rupee equivalent from over 25 investors, a company spokesman said.
The bond has a coupon rate of 8.75 percent a year.
"Ten years is the longest tenor achieved in the sterling market from Asia," he said. "We are also the first manufacturing company in Asia to access the sterling market."
The issue opened up another market for Indian issuers which will low have a benchmark for pricing their debt, he said.

"Our ability to access international markets for competitive debt financing has led to a reduction in average cost of capital coupled with an increase in the average maturity of its debt," the spokesman added.
